title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Origination, Payment Disclosure and Dealer Funding Terms
content:
**Origination terms — Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**1. Tier.** The tier is the one whose credit score band contains the lessee's credit score; with a co-lessee the higher score is used.

**2. Money factor.** The money factor is the tier's base money factor for the term band plus any dealer markup of no more than the tier's maximum markup.

**3. Residual value.** The residual value is MSRP times the residual percentage for the term plus the mileage adjustment points for the contracted allowance, rounded to the dollar. Only the contractable annual allowances may be contracted.

**4. Structure limits.** The lease term may not exceed the tier's longest term; the gross capitalized cost may not exceed the tier's maximum percentage of MSRP; the capitalized cost reduction must be at least the tier's minimum percentage of MSRP; and the total monthly payment may not exceed the tier's maximum percentage of verified gross monthly income.

**5. Payment.** The base monthly payment is the monthly depreciation — the adjusted capitalized cost less the residual value, divided by the term in months — plus the monthly rent charge — the adjusted capitalized cost plus the residual value, times the money factor — the sum rounded to the cent. The monthly use tax is the base monthly payment times the use tax rate percentage, rounded to the cent. The total monthly payment is the base monthly payment plus the monthly use tax.

**6. Figures recorded on the lease.** The lease records the excess mileage rate for the vehicle's class, the disposition fee and the purchase option fee written at booking, and a purchase option price equal to the residual value plus the purchase option fee; the acquisition fee is the tier's acquisition fee.

**7. Security deposit.** Where the tier requires a security deposit, the deposit is one total monthly payment rounded up to the next deposit rounding increment; otherwise no deposit is taken.

**8. Funding window.** The lease may be funded only when the dealer delivers the complete lease package no later than 30 calendar days (the funding window in every tier) after the date the lease was signed. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the lease date, and delivery on the last day is timely. The lease date on the lease record is the anchor; the dealer's statement of when the lease was signed does not replace it.

**9. Funding.** On funding, the adjusted capitalized cost is booked as the opening lease balance.

**Boundary cases for clause 8 (hypothetical dates)**

| Lease date | Package delivered | Day of the window | Funding |
|---|---|---|---|
| March 1 | March 31 | day 30 | timely; may be funded |
| March 1 | April 1 | day 31 | late; may not be funded |

**Worked payment example (all inputs hypothetical)**: adjusted capitalized cost $36000, residual value $22000, term 36 months, money factor 0.00195, use tax rate 6 percent. Monthly depreciation is $14000 divided by 36, that is $388.888…; monthly rent charge is $58000 times 0.00195, that is $113.10; their sum, rounded to the cent, gives a base monthly payment of $501.99. The use tax is $501.99 times 6 percent, $30.1194, rounded to $30.12. The total monthly payment is $532.11. Where the tier requires a deposit rounded up to the next $25, the deposit is $550.
